stage: Rank 6 shared task-label editing and personal catalog separation

nativeBuild.scope: Unsigned arm64 Mac app; isolated helper omits widgets

contract: Shared label names remain literal text, with no personal catalog resolution
Personal catalog normalization/rename/delete excludes known shared tasks and frozen scoped mutations
Same-project visible-task/checklist suggestions, bounded by 2048 nodes,4096 values,200 names
Exact existing strings/order/duplicates are retained until explicit edits; catalog IDs/unsafe names displayed as Saved label
Unsupported future shapes stay read-only; no truncation
New names: 1–100 characters and <=400 UTF-8 bytes; final array <=256 values under unchanged service contract
Apply includes valid unsubmitted name text; invalid text stays in the sheet
Cancel does not change task; Apply stays in iOS parent draft until Save; Mac uses scoped autosave
Role loss keeps sheet and verified encrypted private draft; current editor closure and frozen baseline guard callbacks

Initial reveal helper demanded 60 points below a fully visible bottom debug button. Its final shared-label-form margin is 12 points; saved-task assertions already passed after the initial tap.
Review found Apply would discard an unsubmitted name. Apply now validates/includes it and final native test types without pressing Add.
limitations: Synthetic native fixtures and existing source-only team rollout; no live hosted multi-actor claim
Mac native interaction/VoiceOver and broader native account/concurrency/failed-write acceptance remain open
Remaining native adapters, independent child records and full ranked/Px objective remain open
